issues.title: PA x TFC is temporarily incompatible with 0.8.0.0
symptoms: PA x TFC integration does not work correctly with the latest documented release.
Users may need to remove the bridge mod to stabilize startup or gameplay.
workarounds: Do not use PA x TFC with 0.8.0.0 until the compatibility update is released.

issues.title: Dynamic Trees integration is still work in progress
symptoms: Seasonal tree integration with Dynamic Trees is not considered ready.
workarounds: Leave the Dynamic Trees integration disabled.

issues.title: Startup fails when no season provider is installed
symptoms: The game or server throws an IllegalStateException at startup asking for Serene Seasons, ProjectAtmosphereForTFC, or Ecliptic Seasons.
workarounds: Install a season provider before loading the mod.
If you need an officially documented option, prefer Serene Seasons.

issues.title: The weatherdebug snowstorm command is mis-registered
symptoms: Running /pa weatherdebug snowstorm fails because the handler expects an intensity argument that the command tree does not expose.
workarounds: Do not rely on this command until the argument registration is fixed.
